- Build emits `dist/privacy/index.html` and strict generated asset allowlist recognizes it

- Dedicated **IN_PROGRESS** queue entry `DIC-Q-28-owner-oauth-privacy-policy-20261114`; no READY or DEPLOYED claim

### Full permanent handoff and release plan
[docs/workstreams/ops-privacy-oauth-20261114.md](https://github.com/Schulzet3/The-Dial-In-Collective/blob/feature/owner-oauth-privacy-page-20261114/docs/workstreams/ops-privacy-oauth-20261114.md) includes the original approval scope, precise changed paths, all test receipts, failed unrelated gate, unchanged production state, required owner review of public contact/privacy wording, compliant OAuth Branding values, complete existing release-controller process, external unauthenticated URL checks, one-time Google authorization, independent GitHub/Drive smoke test, and immutable backup-preservation requirements.

### Hard outstanding gates
1. Review public `schulzet3@gmail.com` contact and legal text for suitability/accuracy.

**NO Netlify production deployment, Google OAuth configuration, database/Auth/member changes, secret writes, new scheduled backup, or Drive archive deletion performed.**
